integrity: A self-contained analytic proof and a standard-library 226-assertion checker are included; computations do not replace the infinite proof. No independent validation or external certification is claimed.
scientific_limitations: Fixed-offset connectivity window G(n,(log n+x)/n), independent bond failures and asymptotic laws only; no rates or wider random-graph ensembles. Early fixed-graph average-reliability literature only partly accessible. Historical priority is not conclusively established.
title: Non-self-averaging critical reliability in Erdős–Rényi networks
